annotation.authors_or_issuer: FDA Center for Devices and Radiological Health
key_provisions_or_claims: Recommends non-clinical testing, clinical data and labeling content for premarket submissions of robotically-assisted surgical devices
Defines RASDs as teleoperated, software-controlled systems assisting practitioners with surgical instruments
Draft guidance open for public comment under docket FDA-2026-N-9505
Reflects FDA's current thinking and aims at consistent, efficient review
annotation.summary_en: FDA CDRH draft guidance page giving recommendations on non-clinical testing, clinical data and labeling for premarket submissions of robotically-assisted surgical devices (teleoperated, software-controlled systems). Open for public comment under docket FDA-2026-N-9505; reflects FDA's current thinking to promote consistent, efficient review.
annotation.title_clean: Robotically-Assisted Surgical Devices: Premarket Submission Recommendations (Draft Guidance)
